units.title: Basic Electromagnetic Theory
topics: 1.1. Physical concept of generation of EM Wave.  Static electric & magnetic field of steady electric current.  Electromagnetic field and its radiation from a center fed dipole.
1.2. Elementary radiator  Hertzian dipole; Half-wave dipole, Power radiated by elementary dipole using Poynting Vector method.
uos: 1.b. Explain the basic concepts of electromagnetic wave theory.
1.d. For the given application choose the relevant radiator

units.title: Antenna Terminologies
topics: 2.1. Basic parameters: Aerial and antenna, Antenna Impedance, Radiation Resistance, Radiation Pattern, Beam area and beam efficiency, Isotropic radiator gain, directivity and Gain, radiation intensity, half power BW, polarization, antenna losses, antenna efficiency, affective aperture, effective length of antenna, effects of antenna height, antenna temperature, front to back ratio, antenna field zones
uos: 2.b. Calculate the basic antenna parameters using standard formulas.
2.c. Identify antenna specifications required from standard handbooks.

units.title: Basic Antennas & Arrays.
topics: 3.1. Radiation characteristics of wire antennas: Resonant wire antennas (λ, 2λ), Non Resonant (Rhombic) Antenna
3.4. Antenna Arrays: Uniform linear array, Broad side array, End fire array
uos: 3.a. Select antennas and antenna arrays as per their operating frequency ranges and radiation pattern for the specific applications

units.title: Antennas for Special applications
topics: 4.1. VHF/UHF antennas: Helical antenna, Parabolic reflector antenna, Horn antenna, Micro strip (patch) antenna, Turnstile and super turnstile antenna, slot antenna
4.2. Terrestrial mobile communication antennas: Base station antennas, Mobile station antennas
4.4. DTH receiver system: outdoor unit, antenna system and indoor unit
uos: 4.a. Classify antennas used in VHF/ UHF band
4.a. Explain the concept of Smart Antennas and its applications
4.a. Prepare the specifications for the required indoor or outdoor DTH systems
